chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), who said:
"The people of the earth are mercied; they do not fear, and they fulfilled the trust and acted with truth."
ai.seo_question: What is the condition of the people of earth who fulfill the trust and act with truth?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*'s chapter on earnings, this narration highlights that true righteousness is defined by the fulfillment of divine trust (*al-amanah*) and adherence to truth, which secures believers from the fear of the Hereafter. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the integration of ethical conduct in worldly transactions with spiritual accountability, ensuring that one's livelihood is blessed and secure.
